title: Distress in Adults with Congenital Heart Disease: Screening, Protective and Risk Factors as well as Predictor for Outcome
summary: Increased stress experience can lead to reduced quality of life and deterioration of the disease course in chronic conditions such as congenital heart defects. Therefore, this research project aims to develop a short questionnaire for stress and subsequently investigate the disease course in relation to the present stress level. This will improve psychocardiological support and examine the impact of increased stress on the disease.
conditions: Congenital malformations of cardiac chambers and connections

interventions.name:
No interventions. In addition to routine cardiology diagnostics, the planned study includes a validation study as well as a multifactorial assessment of somatic (patient file) and psychosocial factors via questionaires.
